# contingency-bench

> Benchmark that places an LLM as the subject of a two-alternative concurrent variable-interval procedure, fits the generalized matching law (sensitivity from unreinforced and from total responses, bias), and maps the sensitivity onto the beta of a policy-compression learning agent; runs offline with a simulated subject.

contingency-bench is part of OperantKit, a set of Python/Rust packages for designing and running operant and respondent conditioning experiments (reinforcement schedules, session recording, analysis). Use it to measure how an LLM's choices track relative reinforcement, with exposure equated across conditions and a reference model for interpreting the result. The repository also holds firmware for a fake operant chamber on a Teensy 4.1 (`firmware/teensy41/`, PlatformIO) that speaks the experiment-io serial protocol, for hardware-in-the-loop timing runs; wiring and protocol are in the README's "Hardware (Teensy 4.1)" section. `contingency-bench-hil-latency` turns a sigrok VCD recording of that board into a response-to-reinforcer latency table (median, p95, p99, max) and checks the feeder pulse widths. `contingency-bench-hil-crf` (extra `hil`) runs an OperantKit session (contingency-dsl expression, experiment-io `drive` over pyserial) against the board and writes the OKL log and a summary JSON with the device's own latency report.

## Install

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-bench
pip install 'contingency-bench[llm] @ git+https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-bench'   # live Anthropic API runs
```

## Minimal example

```python
import numpy as np
from contingency_bench import run_benchmark

np.random.seed(0)
result = run_benchmark(["mock-subject"], use_mock=True, steps_per_condition=200,
                       mock_betas={"mock-subject": 0.2})[0]
print(round(result.sensitivity_unreinforced, 2), round(result.estimated_beta, 2))  # 0.38 0.17
```

CLI: `contingency-bench --mock --steps 50`. Live runs use `APILLMClient`, which calls the Anthropic API with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.

## Related packages

- [session-analyzer](https://github.com/OperantKit/session-analyzer): the generalized-matching estimator mirrored here, plus other analyses
- [contingency-py](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-py): time-based schedule engine with Fleshler-Hoffman VI values
- [contingency-rs](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-rs): Rust engine and hardware-in-the-loop bridge
